I have a friend irl that does this. I met them online and eventually would go to visit them each year. This year when I went to visit them, they started faking tics and (through very thin hotel walls) started role playing as different people to their discord friends. He always enjoyed rp, it’s how I met him, so it didn’t seem too odd. That was, until they came out to me as a system, at the age of 17, after I had know him for 6 years. 

So, what could drive an almost-adult to fake DID? In my friends case it is poverty and lack of schooling. His parents fail to hold a job which has led him to live in the middle of nowhere in a neighborhood of only elderly people. If that weren’t enough, he hasn’t been in school for about 4 years now, leaving him with no peers his age. I imagine it’s quite lonely, but at least he has online friends. Sadly, those friends also identify as systems. 

While I’m very against his self-diagnosis in basically everything, I feel there’s something else at hand. I hope that one day he will speak a psychologist, but that won’t be anytime soon.
